src/core/aggregate.ts.name: Bundle mocks into one set
src/core/aggregate.ts.description: Builds a domain-to-service map from registry rows, with only/except filters and per-domain option overrides, plus reset-all.

src/core/handler.ts.name: Mock service recipe
src/core/handler.ts.description: Turns a table of message types and answers into a working service, records every reply in mock.sent, and pushes replies to napplet windows.

src/core/rng.ts.name: Repeatable random values
src/core/rng.ts.description: Seeded random numbers and label-derived hex ids, pubkeys, event ids and placeholder signatures, so every run produces the same values.

src/core/types.ts.name: Shared mock contracts
src/core/types.ts.description: Defines the clock, scheduler, options, control surface, sent-envelope record, spec ref and registry row every mock shares.
